summary: Who gets a semaphore, auto-reset event or mutex released while threads wait for it (Sprint 065; game run 38216081440 seq 1317 and 1402-1508, where all 16 Background Job.Worker waits on one semaphore return and in w2m 15 never did). The release hands the object to the waiters at once, in the order they began to wait: the releaser's own zero-timeout wait right after finds it taken, two units go to the first two of three waiters, and of two waiters the first wakes.
applicability: windows-2022 (AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor); windows-2025 (AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor)

initial.process: started by the runner's cmd with standard output redirected
